items.name: Cernay-lès-Reims 2025
items.information:
L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€.
Merci de lire attentivement les **conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CernaylesReims2025#57650-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. 
Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule). 

----
Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€.
Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CernaylesReims2025#57650-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**.
Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab.

## This is the FMC only competition of Irish Championship 2025.
As FMC is not being held at [Rubik's Irish Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksIrishChampionship2025), this is your chance to become Ireland's Fewest Moves Champion!

Please see all the tabs to see the locations and information of each venue.

*You do not need to attend Rubik's Irish Championship 2025 in Waterford to become the Irish FMC National Champion.*

## This competition is not recommended for newcomers


**Please Note:** As this is the Irish Championship, only competitors who represent Ireland will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

items.name: Vegas Cubing Cup Summer 2025

venue.name: The Orleans Hotel & Casino
venue.address: 4500 W Tropicana Ave, Las Vegas, NV 89103

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VegasCubingCupSummer2025#59167-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is sponsored by [SpeedCubeShop](http://speedcubeshop.com) and [West Coast Cubing](http://westcoastcubing.com)

items.information:

​

items.name: Ashfield Summer Challenge 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3hrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ae8bf56bdf7df2a9ddef232b67ef1762d8b05535/logo_200x200.png)

This competition is organized by Cube New England, a non-profit organization dedicated to the growth of speedcubing in New England.
The only events at this competition will be 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Multiple Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, and 5x5x5 blindfolded. First-time competitors are welcome, however we will not be holding the normal speedsolving events, and so you may prefer to attend a different competition.

* [Visit our **webpage**](https://www.cubenewengland.com)
* [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://www.cubenewengland.com/competitions)
* [Follow us on **Facebook**](https://facebook.com/cubenewengland)
* [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/402975042172435)
* [Join our Facebook community for **parents**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/732527678812618)
* [Join our **Discord**](https://discord.gg/3mX6xKUdRC)
